claim_boundary: V19BZ measures how informative source-only H I/optical geometry is; it does not identify an optical counterpart.
All candidates and all Hydra TR1/TR2 alternatives remain in the outputs.
The margin grid is descriptive and the sufficiency rule is exploratory because source pixels were inspected before the protocol was written.
No candidate property is allowed to weight the spatial score, and no null prior or posterior is invented.
No velocity, rotation curve, lensing result, halo map, gravity residual, action, constant, holdout label or Solar-System result enters this audit.

exploratory_information_sufficiency_rule.interpretation: A failure requires better source information or uncertainty propagation; it does not reject a gravity theory and cannot remove a galaxy.

next_evidence_if_insufficient: uniform optical image cutouts centered on every H I source
a source-only probabilistic mixture that retains ambiguous counterparts
an independent association-validation subset that contains no rotation or gravity target

spatial_model.beam_source: geometric mean of FITS BMAJ and BMIN
spatial_model.normalization: normalize every smoothed positive image to unit sum over its full FITS cutout
spatial_model.optical_weight: none; extended_candidate is carried only as an unweighted diagnostic because SkyMapper DR4 extended-source photometry is not optimized
spatial_model.ranking: descending spatial likelihood ratio with object_id ascending only as a deterministic tie break
spatial_model.signal_image: clip the moment-zero map at zero so negative noise cannot act as counterpart evidence
spatial_model.spatial_likelihood_ratio: sample the normalized image bilinearly at each candidate and divide by the uniform per-pixel density over the same cutout
spatial_model.support_distance: bilinear distance to the nearest nonzero moment-zero pixel, divided by the geometric-mean beam FWHM
